title: Can I LOSE to Worstfish?
summary: Christmas video: the player tries to LOSE against Worstfish, an engine that intentionally plays the worst move on the board (so it gives pieces away and avoids mating). Plan: walk own king into the enemy camp, take away all own king moves, then give check so Worstfish's only legal reply delivers mate. First attempt (Qg3+) fails because the bot can capture with a knight; after removing the knight and covering e4 with d5, the check forces Worstfish to checkmate the player in 16 moves (8th game overall; ~10% accuracy).
rules: Standard chess rules and board; player white (inferred from footage description).
Bot (Worstfish) always plays the worst legal move by engine evaluation.
Goal is reversed: the player wins the challenge by getting checkmated by Worstfish.
win_condition: Get your own king checkmated by Worstfish (self-mate). Video: achieved in 16 moves.
